completed_work: The governance and dependency baseline: hypothesis pinned as a dev dependency with a deterministic gate profile in the importable tests/support/ package (no conftest), the integration/slow/faultmatrix markers with --strict-markers, and the config/tools.json ffmpeg/ffprobe re-probe.

The shared fault-injection kit (DurableIoInterceptor over the four durable_io primitives with golden-run write counting, process-death/ENOSPC/torn-write injection, and control-file corruption helpers) and the extracted KillingExecutor; the synthetic fixture generator with five branches that mirror Phase 11's real-video branches 1:1, probe-verified against the pinned toolchain.
The property layer (time-base and half-open-interval invariants; serialization round-trips across sixteen serialize/deserialize contracts) and the dedicated subtitle_pipeline.py unit file.

The exhaustive orchestration fault matrix (enumerated durable writes × {process death, ENOSPC, torn write} with a recorded-N golden assertion, control-file corruption, and publish/latest-pointer faults) and the two production fixes it surfaced; the first offline end-to-end `vcp run` over the subtitle-first fixture with hash-seeded offline adapters and the three production gaps it surfaced.

The stage-fault tier and real SIGKILL subprocess spot checks recovering via the real CLI; the five-branch CLI acceptance layer (plan/run/status/pause/resume/cancel/verify/inventory plus improve) driving the real composition to published, hash-verified terminals; and this closing exit-gate inventory with tests/acceptance/test_phase_10_inventory.py.
open_requirements: The five 本阶段不能验证 domain-quality questions (real zh/en ASR accuracy, real overlapping-speech quality, real subtitle forced-alignment success, real OCR recall and digit accuracy, real long-video summary faithfulness) are out of reach offline by design and are the subject of Phase 11 real-video testing.
